overview: Medford City Councillor Matt Leming joined the podcast to provide updates on recent council initiatives and municipal developments. Discussion covered override funding allocations, the welcoming city ordinance, comprehensive zoning reform, charter review progress, and recreation programs for youth with disabilities.

items.title: Introduction and Local Dining
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduces City Councillor Matt Leming, who shares his regular local dining spots in Medford.

items.title: November Override Allocations
items.summary: Leming discusses the implementation of approved override questions 7 and 8, which allocated funds to the public schools and three permanent DPW road repair crew positions.

items.title: Recent Council Legislation
items.summary: Leming outlines recently passed measures, including rental incentives for landlords housing veterans and a welcoming city ordinance limiting municipal police cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.

items.title: Comprehensive Zoning Reform
items.summary: Leming explains the city's effort to update its zoning code to streamline business permitting, improve walkability, and provide developer incentives for affordable housing and environmental features.

items.title: City Charter Review Process
items.summary: Leming outlines the legislative path for proposed charter amendments submitted to the council's Governance Committee, including proposed four-year mayoral terms and ward-based representation.

items.title: Therapeutic Recreation and Council Communications
items.summary: Leming highlights council support for hiring therapeutic recreation staff for youth with disabilities, upcoming neighborhood rezonings, and city council newsletters and meeting broadcasts.
